messages:
Ashley: nightly-eval-bot just posted a significant drop in the nightly reasoning-suite-v2 pass@1 for model-redwood-v13. report: https://ci.internal/nightly/1968000000
nightly-eval-bot: nightly eval summary for model-redwood-v13
- dataset: reasoning-suite-v2 (150 prompts)
- overall pass@1: 61.9% (prev: 75.2%)
- biggest regressions: arithmetic, short-chain-of-thought prompts
- suspected cluster: tokenization boundary changes + early-token logit variance after quantization
- artifacts: s3://redwood-nightly/1968000000/report.html
Ashley: fyi @Mike @Ravi @Sara — tagging infra + ML to triage
Mike: I deployed runtime build last night that included tokenizer changes and a new quant profile (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-19-22). Either could be the root cause.
Ravi: quick check: raw weight diffs L2 look normal, but logits after quant show heavier tails on initial tokens (esp tokens 0-7). that can magnify any tokenization offset.
Sara: tried reproducing locally against the v13 artifacts. tokenizer now splits numbered list markers differently — example below. old tokenizer merged "1." into one token; new BPE emits ['1', '.'] which shifts autoregressive steps.
Sara: repro snippet:

```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t_v13 = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizers/redwood_v13.json')
print(t_v13.encode('1. If x=2, what is x+3?').tokens)
# -> ['1', '.', '\u0120If', '\u0120x', '=', '2', ',', '\u0120what', '\u0120is', '\u0120x', '+', '3', '?']

t_v12 = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizers/redwood_v12.json')
print(t_v12.encode('1. If x=2, what is x+3?').tokens)
# -> ['1.', '\u0120If', '\u0120x', '=', '2', ',', '\u0120what', '\u0120is', '\u0120x', '+', '3', '?']
```

Sara: that extra token at step 0 shifts the KV index for all following tokens; with the new quant profile, early-step logits have larger relative variance so the generator often picks punctuation and then truncates the explanation.
Devon: KV misalignment + amplified early logits = plausible root cause. can spin canary mixes to isolate.
Ashley: good. can we test combos (v12 tokenizer + v13 weights, v13 tokenizer + v12 quant) to isolate?
Ravi: I'm rerunning a small matrix: (weights v12/v13) x (tokenizer v12/v13) x (quant profile v12/v13). preliminary: v13 weights + v12 tokenizer + v12 quant is close to baseline. v13 weights + v13 tokenizer + v12 quant still shows some drop but not as bad.
Mike: infra can switch which tokenizer is served independently from weights; we can route nightly eval to use v12 tokenizer quickly if that short-circuits the alerts.
Devon: spinning a canary now: runtime image runtime:v2026-03-19, weights: v13, tokenizer: v12. ETA ~10m.
nightly-eval-bot: canary started: http://ci.internal/canary/1968000000
Devon: quick canary result: reasoning subset pass@1 -> 71.2% (was 61.9). big improvement; looks like tokenizer change is the dominant factor.
Ashley: OK plan: pin serving config for v13 weights to use tokenizer:v12 until tokenizer fix lands. action items:
- Mike: update serving route + deploy pinned tokenizer (owner: Mike)
- Ravi: finish quant isolation experiment & add notes to the nightly report (owner: Ravi)
- Sara: add regression tests for numbered lists, inline math, and list markers; open tokenizer PR with merge fix (owner: Sara)
- Devon: manage canary rollout and pre-warm KV caches (owner: Devon)
Mike: I'll push the route pin now and post the tracking id. will also update the release changelog with the short-term mitigation.
Ravi: isolation results: switching back to older quant profile reduces early logit tails but doesn't fully recover pass@1 alone. combining tokenizer rollback + older quant brings us near previous baseline.
Sara: opened PR for tokenizer merge rule and tests: https://git.internal/redwood/tokenizers/pull/423 — includes unit tests for numbered markers and inline LaTeX-ish constructs.
Devon: added a temp eval webhook to reduce pager noise while we stabilize :white_check_mark:
Mike: route pinned and config updated. tracking id: route-pin-1968000000
Ashley: thanks team. keep updates concise here. once PR merges and nightly stabilizes we'll remove the pin. please add any new failing prompt patterns to Sara's test matrix. :eyes:
